memories.content: Source observation (2026-11-05T08:35:14.089Z) from https://www.imf.org/-/media/files/publications/wp/2025/english/wpiea2025186-source-pdf.pdf?utm_source=openai: **Consensus is how the network agrees on ledger updates** without relying on one central record-keeper. Different blockchains use different approaches. In proof of work, participants expend computing power to propose blocks; in proof of stake, validators participate by committing cryptocurrency under the network’s rules. These are different ways to help the network choose and validate updates; neither is a universal method for every blockchain.
